class.name: VirtualTexture2D
class.brief_description: A texture streamed into video memory a page at a time, as the camera needs it.

method.name: get_fallback_image
method.description: Returns the small copy of the whole texture, at most 256 texels a side, that stands in for it wherever it is not sampled as a virtual texture, and while its pages load.

method.name: get_page_count
method.description: Returns how many pages across and down the texture's mipmap [param mipmap] is cut into. Every mipmap is half the size of the one before it, down to a single page across its narrower side.

method.name: get_page_format
method.description: Returns how the texture's pages are compressed on disk.

method.name: get_page_image
method.description: Reads and returns the page at [param x], [param y] of mipmap [param mipmap], as the renderer receives it: an [constant Image.FORMAT_RGBA8] image of [constant RenderingServer.VIRTUAL_TEXTURE_PAGE_SIZE] texels a side, surrounded by a border of [constant RenderingServer.VIRTUAL_TEXTURE_PAGE_BORDER] texels from its neighbors.

method.name: get_page_mipmap_count
method.description: Returns how many mipmaps the texture's pages are kept at; see [method get_page_count].

method.name: load
method.description: Loads the texture from a [code].vtex[/code] file, as [ResourceImporterVirtualTexture] writes them, and starts streaming from it.

members.member: The path of the [code].vtex[/code] file this texture streams from.

constants.constant: Pages are compressed losslessly, as WebP.
Pages are compressed lossily, as WebP: much smaller on disk, at some cost in quality.
Pages are stored as raw texels, compressed with Zstandard. The fastest to read, and the largest on disk.
